day.headline: A Rabbit day — Goat and Pig are in step.

reasons: Dog pairs with Rabbit — a harmonious day
signs.message: Mute them, don't unfollow. Nobody gets notified, nobody gets hurt.

reasons: Dragon sits apart from Rabbit — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: She's been having a week. Call her, don't text.

reasons: Tiger sits apart from Rabbit — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Get the usual, skip the menu. You've never once regretted it.

reasons: Goat and Rabbit share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: Final week for that place. Go buy the thing you eyed.

reasons: Snake sits apart from Rabbit — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: a table you have to wait for
signs.message: Leave your number, walk the block, come back properly hungry.

reasons: Rooster opposes Rabbit — a day to take slowly
signs.motif: the washing up left until tomorrow
signs.message: Tomorrow arrived. Ten minutes at that sink, then you're free.

reasons: Horse sits apart from Rabbit — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Two weeks left in this one. Pick something to actually finish.

reasons: Pig and Rabbit share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.motif: a project abandoned at eighty percent
signs.message: Open the file, do the easy twenty minutes, close it.

reasons: Monkey sits apart from Rabbit — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Someone helped you and vanished. Nothing to repay, just remember it.

reasons: Rat sits apart from Rabbit — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Let tonight go. Say so before six, then stay put.

reasons: Rabbit's own day — your energy runs high
signs.message: Skip the loop around the block. Couch, straight after dinner.

reasons: Ox sits apart from Rabbit — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: shoes that pinch on one side
signs.message: The left one bites. Wear the soft pair, go slowly.
